outlook.fluid_layout: outer content width=100% max-width:900px; MSO ghost table width=900; @media max-width:600px stacks WHW + cards, body text >=15px, titles ~20px; desktop uses extra width (scoreboard 2-col cards ~406px); tip/news/benchmark body text 15px/22px (match tips)
outlook.tags: plain-text with middot separators; no background pill boxes
outlook.icons: emoji only; no colored square behind icons
outlook.whw_layout: 2-column table desktop (label td width=52 valign=top); stacks label above text on mobile via .si-label/.si-text-col display:block
outlook.read_more: plain underlined text link (Outlook-safe) or VML bulletproof button
outlook.header: solid bgcolor=#0f1f3d on header td/table; keep gradient in style; MSO VML solid navy fill best-effort for desktop Outlook dark; force light text via class/data-ogsc
outlook.bgcolor_every_td: every td/table has solid bgcolor (#FAF8F3 body/cards or #0f1f3d header)
outlook.ios_outlook_dark_note: Outlook iOS may still force a dark purple surface despite color-scheme=light + data-ogsc/bgcolor; if so, stop chasing — keep text readable on forced dark via .si-on-dark / header light text
outlook.body_font: 15px/22px tip, news, scoreboard card body/notes/Top3/This week
